segment.source: Renders a mobile-app opening: copy on one side, a device shot on the other, and a row of store links each carrying its own icon and platform name. Use it for: app landing pages, store campaign pages, the download page a QR code points at, beta programme invitations. Prefer 'Split Media Hero' when the product is not an app and the links are ordinary buttons, and 'Product Hero' when the screenshot is a desktop interface rather than a phone.
